output.summary: A plum species growing as a large shrub or small tree, native to Southeast Europe and Western Asia. It is among the first European trees to flower in spring, often blooming before its leaves open. Its edible yellow or red fruits may be sweet enough to eat fresh or sour and better suited to jam.
output.edibilityNote: Fruits are edible; sweet varieties are eaten fresh, while sour ones are used for jam and in Georgian cuisine.
